thread:
matt: deploy-bot blocked roll v3.1.0 in preflight. SBOM present but cosign expired signature timestamp for linux/arm64. Also vuln-scan found 1 medium in transitive lib (lib-async) used by a non-critical SDK. change window tonight 01:00 UTC. options: rollback, pin, or carveout? @anya @legal @ops
anya: paste the deploy-bot output?
deploy-bot: auto: preflight report for redwood-inference@v3.1.0
  - SBOM: present (sbom.json)
  - cosign: signature timestamp 2022-11-01 -> expired key rotation mismatch
  - vuln-scan: 1 medium (CVE-2024-ABCD) in transitive lib-async (sdk-dev runtime)
  - policy: expired-cosign -> advisory but requires manual approval for global rollout
matt: key rotation happened and we rotated signing key last month. this artifact was signed with the older key; cosign verifies but timestamp flagged as expired by deploy policy.
ops: quick question  does the digest match the release tag in the registry? If yes we could attach a vouch record.
anya: digest matches. We can re-sign the existing digest with new key using ephemeral attestation if infra permits. That will take ~40 minutes manual run.
legal: we need evidence of chain-of-custody to approve re-signing: build logs, who triggered build, and CI run ids. Also need confirmation this vulnerability in lib-async does not affect customer data or auth flows.
sec-bot: vuln details: CVE-2024-ABCD - medium - path shows it's used in a client sampling SDK; exploitability low for production flows. recommended mitigation: disable optional sampling in config for rollout.
matt: propose plan:
  - A: Hold global release, re-sign digest with new key and attach cosign (ETA 40m), then proceed global in next change window.
  - B: Allow EU canary (1% weight) for 3h with sampling disabled and increased telemetry, legal + security manual approval.
  - C: Rollback to v3.0.7 and run follow-up rebuild with proper signing.
ops: prefer B if legal ok. can schedule canary and set automated rollback triggers: error >1% or security alert.
anya: re-signing by digest is doable but must be run from eng-infra pipeline CI job to produce provenance record; manual action may break audit trace. I'm leaning to A for clean audit.
matt: timeline: change window in 1.5h. If we choose A we'll miss tonight and be delayed 24h. B keeps momentum but adds risk.
legal: we can approve a limited canary if security signs off and we include a short risk statement in the release notes and an explicit audit ticket created. Also require a one-time waiver tag: "policy-waiver:cosign-expired" and require postmortem.
sec-bot: security approves canary with conditions: sampling disabled, IDS baseline enabled, log-collection high, and security engineer on-call watching for 3h.
ops: I'll prepare deploy job: region=EU, weight=1%, duration=3h, health checks=[error-rate, latency, p50], rollback triggers as above, manual hold at +90m. job will be rb-90012.
matt: release note snippet:
```
Policy waiver: cosign signature timestamp for redwood-inference@v3.1.0 reflects prior key rotation. We are proceeding with a 1% EU canary for 3 hours with optional sampling disabled due to an untriaged medium CVE in a transitive dev SDK. Mitigations: sampling disabled, increased logging, IDS rule active. Approvers: legal + security. Audit ticket: INC-2001. Postmortem required within 72h.
```
anya: adding the waiver tag and filing INC-2001 now.
ops: deploy scheduled: rb-90012 -> EU 1% at 2025-01-14T01:00:00Z. Manual hold at +90m.
legal: approved at 23:12 UTC pending evidence packet delivered before canary start.
matt: sent build logs + ci job ids + registry digest proof to legal.
sec-bot: monitoring checklist: enable IDS rule id=IDS-324, set log level=debug for canary pods, create alerts for unexpected egress.
ops: canary started. rb-90012 status: running -> 1% EU.
ops: 01:35 UTC update: error rate 0.02%, IDS baseline only, debug logs streaming.
anya: re-sign attempt queued but will wait until canary completes to preserve audit trail.
matt: 02:00 UTC manual hold: security review green, continue.
ops: 04:05 UTC final: canary finished, no incidents, rolling plan approved for gradual global rollout next change window.
legal: closing note: waiver logged, evidence attached, will review postmortem.
matt: filing follow-up ticket to add cosign step to feature-branch pipelines (INC-2002). thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
